title: RETURNS & REFUNDS
officialText:
Last updated Dec 01, 2025
OUR PROMISE TO YOU
We would like to assure our valued customers that every item sold by Cozeware undergoes rigorous quality control inspections, ensuring a topnotch product experience. Our commitment to providing excellent furniture products is further strengthened by our comprehensive warranty policy. Rest assured, all items purchased directly from Cozeware are covered by the following warranties.
(Please note that we will not take responsibility for purchases made through other websites selling Cozeware branded products.)
30 DAYS WORRY-FREE RETURN
We will accept returns and exchanges of eligible items in new and unused/resealable condition within 30 days of receipt, at our sole discretion. A valid proof of purchase would be required.
Note: Excluding installed products.
ABOUT RETURN
-A 20% restocking fee will be deducted for returns not due to quality problems. This fee will be deducted from your refund.
-Only items in as-new condition can be returned. Products with scratches, stains, damages, drilling, or any other modification will not be accepted.
-Returns must include all original packaging materials to ensure safe transport. Items returned without the original manufacturer's packaging may not qualify for refund eligibility.
-Certain items cannot be returned, exchanged, or canceled, including: clearance items, final sale items, deals or items damaged through normal wear and tear after delivery.
ABOUT REFUND
-A 20% restocking fee will be deducted for returns not due to quality problems. This fee will be deducted from your refund.
PROOF OF PURCHASE
To validate the return or exchange, please provide any of the following information:
-Valid Order Number
-Take photos of items includes the Cozeware logo and product label
-Email address used at the time of purchase
-Transaction ID of credit card / PP used at the time of purchase
We are unable to accept any items for return or exchange without proof of purchase.
DAMAGED OR DEFECTIVE ITEMS
Upon delivery, please inspect your item(s) and contact us if there's any missing parts, faults, damage or incorrect items within 14 days. Please make sure to take some pictures or a quick video demonstrating the problems allow us to greatly speed up the process for you.
RETURN ITEMS TO COZEWARE WAREHOUSE
Upon approval of your return request, we will send you a return label with the appropriate return address. Items without a Return Authorization (RA) or returned after 14 days will be rejected and sent back to you. We can not accept returns without original packaging and reserve the right to deny refunds for items of unacceptable quality.
You are also allowed to choose other logistics providers to return, but please contact our CS team to confirm the return address. After sending out the item, you will be required to provide a valid tracking number.
Please note: Do not return to the address on the package without permission to ensure a smooth refund, please follow the return instructions above.
Return Process
Request a Return – Email our support team to submit your return request.
Request Review – We will respond within 48 hours (excluding weekends and holidays).
Return Authorization – Once your return request is approved, you will receive an authorization email.
Ship Your Item – Send the item back within 14 days of receiving the return authorization.
In-Transit Time – Return shipments typically take 7–14 days to arrive at our warehouse.
Item Inspection – We will inspect the returned item within 3–5 business days after it is received.
Refund Confirmation Email – After the inspection is approved, you will receive an email within 48 hours confirming that your refund has been approved.
Refund Processing – Your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 7 business days after approval.
Bank/Payment Processing Time – Depending on your bank or payment provider, it may take an additional 5–7 business days for the funds to appear in your account. Some banks may only reflect the refund in the next monthly statement.
ORDER CHANGE OR CANCELLATION
If you wish to modify or cancel your order, please contact us before shipment is processed. You will receive a pre-shipment notification, you are able to request changes or cancellations without incurring fees.
Once the item is shipped out, any changes or cancellation will incur a 20% restocking fee for all returned items that are not due to quality issues, this fee would be deducted from your refund.
Upon canceling items in your order, the total value of the original discount voucher will not be redistributed. However, the remaining items will retain their initial discount value. Discount codes and vouchers are single-use and non-transferable, except where specified in the Order Change and Cancellation Policy.
HANDLING TIME OF REFUNDS
Refund only (no return): Upon request acceptance, Refund will commence within 3 business days.
Refund with return: Refund will commence within 7 business days after all returned items have been sent back to our warehouse.
Funds will be processed back in the same way they were paid to Cozeware, i.e. back to your Credit Card, PayPal or Bank Account. For credit cards, depending on your card issuer's policy, it may take up to 5 to 7 business days for the refund to appear on your account. However, refunds for some banks may only be reflected in your next monthly statement.
WHY DO YOU HAVE A RESTOCKING FEE POLICY FOR RETURNS?
Accepting returned items places a substantial burden on our operations. The process of receiving, inspecting, and restocking merchandise requires extensive time, effort, and resources from our team. Furthermore, a significant portion of returned products cannot be resold due to improper packaging or transit-related damage. To offset these operational costs, we must impose restocking fees on returned items.
